# Code of conduct

We want collaboration on `mlx-smolvla` to be safe, technically rigorous, and
welcoming. Treat other participants with respect, critique ideas and evidence
rather than people, avoid harassment or discriminatory language, and protect
private information shared during debugging.

Project spaces include issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and other
channels used to represent the project. Maintainers may edit or remove abusive,
threatening, deceptive, spammy, or privacy-violating contributions and may
temporarily or permanently restrict participation when needed to protect the
community.

For an ordinary disagreement, use the repository discussion and review tools.
For sensitive conduct concerns, contact a maintainer privately through a
channel listed on their GitHub profile; do not disclose another person's
private information in a public issue. Reports will be handled as discreetly
and promptly as practical.
